date: Nov 22, 2026 · Week 2 / Day 7 · Weekly synthesis and decision review

cards.title: One gate, not five opinions
cards.question: PCIe margin is thin, PDN droop is conditional, and layout freeze is tomorrow. What decision do you request?
cards.selfCheck: Recommend go, conditional-go or hold against explicit criteria. State top exposure, evidence gap, decision owner and checkpoint.
cards.prompt: Run a tough release-gate simulation. Give me conflicting PCIe and PDN evidence; require a 45-second recommendation and challenge my decision criteria.

cards.title: Preserve the escape hatch
cards.question: A connector ECO gains 0.7 dB but costs five days. Can you defer the irreversible choice safely?
cards.selfCheck: Compare risk of delay with the cost of losing the option. Set a last responsible decision date and measurable trigger.
cards.prompt: Coach me through a connector ECO versus schedule decision. Test whether my fallback and last responsible moment are credible.

cards.title: Agreement is not closure
cards.question: SI, layout and validation agree a NEXT miss matters, but nobody owns the fix. How do you close?
cards.selfCheck: Name one accountable integrator, contributors, acceptance metric and due date. Confirm the decision in a short written log.
cards.prompt: Role-play a crosstalk review where each team deflects ownership. Help me secure an accountable owner without formal authority.

cards.title: Don't average conflicting truths
cards.question: EM predicts a clean TDR; bench shows a repeatable impedance dip. Does the team sign off?
cards.selfCheck: Separate measurement confidence from model confidence. Define the discriminating check, release consequence and conditional decision.
cards.prompt: Challenge me as a skeptical validation lead. Make me propose a falsifiable EM/TDR test and an evidence-based signoff threshold.

cards.title: The 60-second decision board
cards.question: In one minute, brief a director on PCIe margin, PDN resonance and crosstalk before the release gate.
cards.selfCheck: Lead with recommendation; rank risks by consequence and timing; give owners, decision triggers and next checkpoint. Then compress to 20 seconds.
cards.prompt: Act as a director. Give me a realistic three-risk SI/PI release case, score my 60-second decision brief, interrupt me, then require a 20-second version. Review Week 1 risk-first communication and Week 2 tradeoffs.
